resources.string: Boox Notes’ pen speed, lent to other apps

In Boox Notes the stroke appears under the nib at once, because the display draws it directly instead of waiting for the app. Instant ink switches that same path on while an app you pick is in front: a preview stroke lands the moment the pen touches, and shortly after you lift, the app’s own stroke takes its place. The app itself is not changed and still receives every pen movement.

Shorter swaps sooner; if a stroke flickers or appears twice, give the app more time.

The preview is Boox’s own brush in black, not the app’s brush, colour or eraser: those appear when the app’s stroke takes over, shortly after the lift or at once when the pen leaves the screen. Pencil is textured and can look broken at small widths, so Fountain pen is the default. While the pen’s eraser end is near, the preview pauses. Instant ink needs no special access; it runs as a small foreground service so Android doesn’t freeze it behind the drawing app. Turn off or Recover screen ends it at once.
